new_results.statement: For independent banks Z,V,W, scalar U=u(Z) with cap M_U, scalar caps M_V,M_W and arbitrary measurable H(Z), H(Z)+2 beta U V+gamma W^2+affine has density cap 4 sqrt(2) M_W sqrt(M_U M_V)/sqrt(|beta gamma|), and a continuous density.
For independent U,V in R^2 with density caps M_U,M_V and invertible cross matrix N, arbitrary both-side quadratic-affine phases give ||p||_p <= p^(1-1/p)(M_U M_V)^((1-1/p)/2)|det N|^(-(1-1/p)/2).

For disjoint physical banks compressing to U,V in R^2 and scalar W, if the selected quadratic factors through those projections, d!=0 and Schur cross N=M-rs^T/d is invertible, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=8 sqrt(3)|d|^-1/2|det N|^-1/4.

stress_family.formula: Q_m=(U1+V1)^2-(U2+V2)^2+W^2 with three disjoint diffuse banks
stress_family.old_physical_pivot_bound: 4 sqrt(6m) on the natural Schur cut

next_step: Use exterior-three mass and current overlap-class identities to prove a bank-first extraction into regularized diffuse determinant, definite two-bank, rank-one cross-square absorption, or two-by-two bank Schur-plus-square; otherwise isolate a genuine nonseparable residual without rotating away product independence.
